prompt: Make a transparent pixel-art atlas exactly five rows by six orthographic views. Rows in supplied source order: clean diner checker tile floor, worn checker tile floor, cracked checker tile floor, wet checker tile floor, checker tile edge transition. Columns FRONT TOP RIGHT LEFT BOTTOM REAR. Preserve exact checker colors, crack/wear/water state and any edge stripe direction from each original. These are thin horizontal floor tiles, so FRONT/RIGHT/LEFT/REAR are thin horizontal edge profiles at the same height, TOP is the exact square pattern viewed overhead, BOTTOM is the matching plain underside footprint with no water, cracks are structural where visible. For edge tile preserve one-sided stripe location and its direction; side profiles show the stripe only on the corresponding side. Isolated square tile, no surrounding floor/background/shadow, full footprint, transparent pixels, no text/perspective.
